content:
Hannah: From today's presales call  enterprise requires processing in Frankfurt (eu-central-1) with deterministic failover to Montreal (ca-central-1). Strict: control plane must not transit US. BYOK (customer-managed HSM) required. Any immediate ops/legal blockers?
Ravi: Hosted control plane is US by default. Two practical POC paths: (A) Private control plane deployed into customer VPC (fast, no US transit); (B) Dedicated with regional control-plane (requires contract amendment). Recommend Private for POC.
Ravi: Data plane: we can tenant-pin inference to eu-central-1 and enable failover to ca-central-1. Note: default telemetry/metrics aggregation may call home to our central endpoints unless telemetry exports are disabled.
Keiko: BYOK supported if keys live in customer's cloud account. We'll need: VPC peering/PrivateLink, IAM service account, KMS grant and key policy review, and certs for control-plane endpoints. If customer needs HSM in DE instead of CA, extra steps for region mapping.
LegalBot: Action: produce subprocessor list (cloud provider legal names + countries) and confirm whether any support tooling or logs include US-hosted endpoints. We'll add SOW clause: "control plane resident in customer VPC; telemetry exports disabled; subprocessor register provided."
Ravi: Pricing: propose two SKUs: POC (30d) = setup fee + small reserved capacity + egress buffer for DE<->CA failover tests; Prod = Dedicated/Private monthly commit + BYOK integration fee + optional SLA uplift. Also account for staff hours for DR runbooks and failover testing.
Hannah: Customer profile: ~120 RPS peak, avg 35k tokens/day, retention 7d, plan staged canary -> cutover. They will host keys in ca-central-1 HSM.
Keiko: Estimate 28-50 eng hours for Private deploy + peering + KMS hookup. POC timeline ~8-12 business days if customer provides network contacts and runbook quickly.
SRE-Bot: Ticket GEO-POC-221 created and assigned to Keiko: "eu-central-1 primary / ca-central-1 failover / customer BYOK".
Hannah: I'll share this thread with the buyer and schedule an ops sync tomorrow. @Ravi please add routing snippet and pricing options to the deck.
